body:
P2-29 BUILT, NOT WALKED (PR #107). What was ruled and how it was built, for the lead and the advisor. Tests are fakes only (no device, no emulator, no VM).

WHICH IMPORT PATH THE OWNER'S TAP USES (check a). import_screen.dart:40 sends EVERY Encore server to EncoreImportScreen (`serverKindProvider == ServerKind.encore`); that route has existed since 22 Oct (972658f), so it is in build 160, and the owner's server is an Encore server (his 6 Nov import ended with `POST imports/{im}/stop`, which only the Encore server has). So covering `EncoreImport` answers his report. The legacy `ImportsController` (the old fetch service, plain music servers only) is untouched: its end is still the opt-in news alert. READ from the code and the board, not run on his phone.

IMPORT.PROGRESS (check b). It is the default and it is used, but it cannot be the only source: the server pushes it only when a song is MATCHED and when an import is stopped (imports/service.py), never when the keeper stores a song, so `kept` moves silently for tens of minutes after the matching, which is the long part. So: resync by `GET imports` at start, on every (re)connection and on coming back to the app, take the pushes as they come, and ask again every 10 s ONLY while an import is running or still saving (no idle poller; patience 30 min with no change, history older than 24 h never shown). docs/17 section 4 now says what the server sends (flat) and a server test pins the shape. PROPER FIX FOR THE LEAD TO FILE: the server publishes `import.progress` (or keep.progress for the import's playlist) when the keeper stores a song of an import; then the 10 s asking can go.

OPTION B BUILT. One card, one id (7410): live while the app is in front (S-16's line word for word, posted with a 3 min time to live, re-posted every minute); from the moment the app is left (lifecycle hidden/paused/detached; `inactive`, the shade pulled over the app, is NOT leaving) the dated card on the SAME id, no time to live, no bar, no reason, posted at once and not paced. Outside the app a download the server is done with has no card. Results: one card per job (ready offline only when every song is on the phone; 3 songs did not come; import end; Import stopped only when stopped elsewhere). Single songs: none. Nothing without the permission; the question is also asked at the first Import. The downloader posts nothing (group card config removed, wording test and Cancel button gone); the transport comment is corrected (B-135).

NEW SENTENCES: none for the card. The English table is ONE class (domain/download_card_words.dart), whole-message functions; the drawing's Arabic stays as the fixture of N-41. Drawing amended: lock-screen frame now the dated wording, captions say live reasons are in the app only, the cost and N-40 are named.

NOT DONE ON PURPOSE: the 6-hourly job; a Stop button (N-39); legacy imports. READ, NOT RUN: the 4-file tail and Notifications.kt:629. A merged import+download whose import is stopped elsewhere shows no "Import stopped" card (the download goes on).
